tagline: Not just a daycare. A cool little kid hangout with learning, love, and a whole lot of heart.

announcement.text: Enrollment forms are going out now. Current openings: 1 infant spot and 2 toddler spots.

announcements.title: The time has come
announcements.text: Enrollment forms are going out to families. Right now Little Cove has room for 1 more infant and 2 more toddlers. If you need a form, send a message and we’ll get you pointed in the right direction.

announcements.title: State visit is finally on the schedule
announcements.text: The state is coming out for our pre-licensing visit, which is a huge step. We’re still decorating, cleaning, sorting classrooms, and making the space feel warm and welcoming. It may look a little plain at first, but the cozy touches are coming.

announcements.title: Yes, we have a playground coming
announcements.text: The fenced-in playground area is right across the alley from the building. Our focus is getting everything ready inside for opening, but outdoor play is absolutely part of the plan.

features: Learning centers, pretend play, books, and hands-on activities
